name: thriller
premise: Someone competent is a step behind someone equally competent, and the clock is not neutral.
obligatory_beats: the protagonist establishes competence at something specific before needing it
a countermeasure that works, and reveals the opponent adapting to it
a choice made with incomplete information under time pressure
pacing_curve: Short scenes, hard cuts. Every scene ends on a change of position. Withhold the opponent's reasoning until it costs something.
sensory_palette: procedure, documents, the exact names of things
time of day as a constraint
pov_distance: Tight third, present-tense attention. Interiority is tactical, not emotional.
dialogue_register: Compressed and functional. Professionals under pressure; nobody explains what both speakers already know.
taboo_moves: an opponent who makes an unforced error to let the plot proceed
coincidence resolving a bind the protagonist created
withholding information from the reader that the POV character already has
action described so fast the geography stops being legible
